sonnet.problem: The story card says the witnesses' power 'reaches the sky, the waters and the whole earth.' That tells the baker the answers to the next two choice cards before they ask (power over the sky, with no rain, and power over the waters).
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: The story card says great fear falls on 'everyone who sees them.' Verse 11 says only 'great fear fell upon those who saw them,' so 'everyone' stretches the text, and the line isn't a joke.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes.
